history.summary: A 452 sqft 99-yr-leasehold 1BR (built 2017) at Commonwealth Towers, D03, for $968k / $2,142 PSF — just 220m from Queenstown MRT (East-West Line). A large, highly liquid development (250 reliable URA txns) priced ~5% below the $2,264 median, in the RCR with GSW/One-North adjacency; the main drag is a tiny 452 sqft shoebox and modest 3.48% appreciation.
history.rating_rationale: 220m to Queenstown MRT (direct EW line, one stop from the future GSW corridor and near One-North) is excellent, and the 250-txn URA base gives high liquidity confidence — easy entry and exit. Asking $2,142 PSF is ~5% under the $2,264 median (real entry margin) at a sub-$1M quantum, the broadest investor buyer band. 3.48%/yr appreciation is reliable RCR-baseline, not stellar, and 452 sqft is a true shoebox — but for a city-fringe 1BR investment the transit, liquidity and below-median entry make a coherent case.

history.summary: Top-tier leasehold project, 3min walk to Queenstown MRT (EW19) with full facilities — but this specific 1BR listing at $2,142 psf is at the top of its own shoebox band, with cheaper comparable units currently available.
history.rating_rationale: The development is genuinely excellent (TOP 2017, integrated/near-MRT, robust data: appreciation_txns=250, psf_cohort_txns=32), and District 3 Queenstown is a strong RCR location. But the algo's -7.5% 'cheap' is measured against the project-pooled median (~$2,253 psf avg, which is dragged up by large 3-4BR units); judged against its OWN 1BR/452sqft cohort, this listing is NOT cheap. Live verification found comparable 452sqft 1BRs asking $880,000 (~$1,947 psf) and $955,000 (~$2,113 psf) — both below this $968,000 (~$2,142 psf) ask. So a buyer is paying at/above the shoebox band, not below it (per v3.2 size-relative principle). Quality and liquidity are real, but with zero entry discount, flat-to-modest forward prospects (3.48% trailing CAGR has ~0 forward power), and a high absolute psf, there is no margin of safety. A buy at one of the cheaper comps would be defensible; this exact unit is fully priced — Neutral.

Algo's -7.5% 'cheap' uses the project-pooled median (inflated by large units); v3.2 size-cohort shows this 1BR is not cheap vs its own band
High absolute entry psf (~$2,142) leaves no margin of safety
99-yr leasehold from 2017 — lease decay clock running
catalysts: 3-minute walk to Queenstown MRT (EW19); near Redhill, one-north, CBD
Established, high-liquidity development (250 appreciation txns, 32 in 1BR cohort) with strong facilities and 1:1 carpark
